events.headline: TypeSafe announces an $870M Series A at a $7.5B valuation, led by a16z.
events.label: Official announcement
events.note: Financing and company plans; no new Jev model version is announced.

events.headline: Microsoft launches Microsoft-Decision-1; Vercel adds TypeSafe-compatible access.
events.label: Microsoft announcement
events.note: Independent hosted decision model; performance claims are vendor-reported. [Vercel integration](https://vercel.com/changelog/microsoft-decision-1-now-available-on-ai-gateway).

events.headline: Cloudflare releases Clef and Clef-flash, open-weight multimodal decision models with Jev-compatible interfaces.
events.label: Announcement
events.note: [Clef](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef) and [Clef-flash](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-flash) weights and inference code are available. Launch discussion: [626 points / 217 comments on Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49923692), observed 2026-10-04.

events.headline: JevSpawn proposes adaptive agentic inference with compositional action spaces.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: AutoTrust releases JEV-27B-VL, an independent open-weight model for typed decisions over text and images.
events.label: Announcement
events.note: [Apache-2.0 weights](https://huggingface.co/autotrust/JEV-27B-VL) and serving code are public. The author announcement has 165 Hugging Face upvotes, observed 2026-10-08. This is the September 30 release, added retrospectively.

events.headline: Chinese-Jev introduces Chinese-language decision training and CJ-Bench.
events.label: Paper
events.note: Weights remain pending in the checked repository.

events.headline: A broad Jev evaluation examines 37 datasets, calibration, and answer formats.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: JevOut investigates how natural-looking context can redirect typed decisions.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Visual Jev explores efficient decisions over shared visual context.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Jev-Mem introduces a System One controller for agent memory.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Laya 0.1.0 is published on PyPI, an early runtime release in the open decision-model ecosystem.
events.label: Release
events.note: This dates the Python package, not the model checkpoints.

events.headline: Vercel adds Jev to AI Gateway.
events.label: Announcement

events.headline: TypeSafe AI introduces Jev and System One models.
events.label: Original announcement
